en.t: What could possibly be so difficult about it?

units.source_text: 是不是七段明知应下“18·十三”位跳，却故意不下而消磨时间？

en.t: Was the seventh dan, though fully aware that he ought to jump at the 18-13 point, deliberately refusing to play there in order to use up time?
The staff too were unusually anxious.

units.source_text: 七段作为对弈者，谈感想时说过：

en.t: Speaking later as one of the players, the seventh dan said when giving his impressions:

units.source_text: 当时他犹豫是应在“18·十三”位跳呢，还是在“18·十二”位爬。

en.t: At the time he had been wavering over whether to jump at the 18-13 point or crawl at the 18-12 point.

units.source_text: 名人在某次讲评时也说：

en.t: The Meijin also said during one commentary session:
This was precisely a moment when gain and loss were hard to distinguish.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，续弈的最初一手，大竹七段用了三个半小时。

en.t: Even so, Otake seventh dan spent three and a half hours on the first move after play resumed.

units.source_text: 总之给人一种异样的感觉。

en.t: In any case, it gave one a strange impression.

units.source_text: 下完这一手，秋阳已经西沉，电灯也亮了。

en.t: By the time this move had been played, the autumn sun had already sunk in the west, and the electric lights had come on.
